summary: A KPI card on a gradient field whose hue and angle drift slowly through registered CSS custom properties; the pointer takes over and paints it.
use: Hero backgrounds, dashboard headers and cards that need ambient color without video, canvas or a JavaScript loop.
spec: `@property --hue` is a `<number>` and `@property --angle` is an `<angle>`, so CSS can interpolate them
`animation: field-drift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate` runs only while `m.playing && !driven`
Takeover: `hue` follows the pointer x (0 to 90) and `angle` follows y (0 to 360), written as `--hue` and `--angle`
Reduced motion: `m.playing` is false, so nothing animates and the field stays at `135deg`
